ui.an_administrator_must_give_a_reason: Umphathi kufanele anikeze isizathu. Ukukhishwa kurekhodwa emlandweni wokucwaningwa.
ui.automatic_protection_keeps_running_on: Ukuvikelwa okuzenzakalelayo kuyaqhubeka kuyo yonke idivayisi. Lezi yizenzo ezidinga umuntu ukuthi anqume.
ui.by_default_the_agent_sends_security: Ngokuzenzakalelayo i-ejenti ithumela i-telemetry yokuphepha nama-hash amafayela: amagama ezinqubo nemigqa yemiyalo, izindlela zamafayela, imethadatha yokuxhumana kwenethiwekhi, nokutholiwe. Okuqukethwe kwamafayela kuqoqwa kuphela uma inhlangano yakho ikuvulile lokho.
ui.critical_alert_delivery_p95_30_days: ukulethwa kwezexwayiso ezibucayi kakhulu (p95, izinsuku ezingu-30)
ui.during_the_free_trial_and_on: Ngesikhathi sesilingo samahhala, nasezinhlelweni ezingakhokhelwa, ikhonsoli ibonisa izikhangiso ze-Google AdSense futhi izinhlelo zeselula zibonisa izikhangiso ze-Google AdMob, ngemva kokucela imvume yakho. Ababhalisile babona izikhangiso ezimbalwa ngo-95%. Izikhangiso azivele zivele kuzikrini zemvume, zokuvimba, zezexwayiso zosongo, zokubuyekeza ukuvalelwa, zokungena, zokukhokha noma zokucwaningwa.
ui.each_publish_creates_a_new_signed: Ukushicilela ngakunye kudala inguqulo entsha esayiniwe. Amadivayisi aqhubeka nokusebenzisa inguqulo yokugcina eqinisekisiwe ngenkathi engaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi.
ui.equality_software_ltd_operates_agenti: I-Equality Software Ltd isebenzisa i-Agentic Antivirus. Leli khasi lichaza lokho okuqoqwa yisevisi. Kumele libuyekezwe ngumnikazi womkhiqizo ngaphambi kokushicilelwa.
ui.every_action_that_changes_a_device: Zonke izenzo ezishintsha idivayisi, i-akhawunti noma ithrafikhi zidlula enjinini yenqubomgomo nokuphatha kwe-AEP-X. Imvume ihlanganisa isenzo esisodwa, okuhlosiwe kwaso ngqo, le nhlangano, nesikhathi esinqunyiwe.
ui.every_upload_is_checked_for_malware: Konke okulayishiwe kuhlolwa i-malware nohlobo lwakho lwangempela. Amafayela angenasibukeli esiqinisekisiwe ayagcinwa futhi ayalandeka kodwa awabukwa kuqala.
ui.get_the_agent_for_windows_mac: Thola i-ejenti ye-Windows, Mac noma Linux ku-
ui.go_to_devices_choose_enrol_a: Iya kokuthi Amadivayisi, ukhethe Bhalisa idivayisi, bese uqalisa umyalo oboniswayo kukhompyutha ofuna ukuyivikela. I-ejenti iqala ukuskena ngokushesha nje lapho ithola inqubomgomo yayo esayiniwe.
ui.i_understand_devices_will_stop_scanni: Ngiyaqonda ukuthi amadivayisi azoyeka ukuskena nokuvimba izinsongo ngemva kwesilingo kuze kukhokhelwe okubhaliselwe.
ui.include_the_language_model_if_your: Faka imodeli yolimi (uma inhlangano yakho iyivulile)
ui.known_malware_is_moved_to_quarantine: I-malware eyaziwayo ihanjiswa ekuvalelweni, lapho ingakwazi ukusebenza khona. Uma ucabanga ukuthi ifayela livinjwe ngephutha, vula Ukuvalelwa bese ucela ukubuyekezwa. Umphathi uyanquma, futhi ifayela libuya kuphela ngemva kokuthi ukuskena okusha kulithole lihlanzekile.

ui.name_of_the_secret_in_your: Igama lemfihlo endaweni yakho yokugcina izimfihlo, hhayi imfihlo ngokwayo
ui.on_android_subscribe_in_the_agentic: Ku-Android, bhalisa ohlelweni lwe-Agentic Antivirus nge-Google Play. Ku-iPhone naku-iPad, ukubhalisa nge-App Store akukatholakali. Ukukhokha kuwebhu akukatholakali.
ui.read_aloud_and_dictation_use_your: Ukufunda ngokuzwakalayo nokubhala ngezwi kusebenzisa izici zokukhuluma ezakhelwe esipheqululini sakho. Asirekhodi noma sigcine umsindo.
ui.stopping_processes_isolating_devices_: Ukumisa izinqubo, ukuhlukanisa amadivayisi, ukubuyisela amafayela, ukwengeza okukhishiwe nokushintsha imithetho yethrafikhi kudinga umuntu ukuthi akuvume. Imvume ihlanganisa isenzo esisodwa, okuhlosiwe kwaso ngqo nesikhathi esilinganiselwe. Uma kukhona okushintshayo, phinda uvume.
ui.the_assistant_groups_related_alerts_l: Umsizi uqoqa izexwayiso ezihlobene, ubala okubonwe nezixhumanisi eziya ebufakazini, futhi umaka noma yini angakwazi ukuyifakazela njengomcabango. Angaphakamisa izenzo kodwa akakwazi ukuzivuma. Uma imodeli ingatholakali, ukuskena, izexwayiso nezimpendulo zesandla kuyaqhubeka nokusebenza.
ui.tls_only_must_be_on_the: I-TLS kuphela, kufanele ibe kuhlu lwezivunyelwe ukuphuma
ui.traffic_floods_are_absorbed_by_your: Izikhukhula zethrafikhi zimuncwa ngumhlinzeki wakho ophezulu. Lapha uphendula ngawo wonke amaphoyinti omphakathi, uqaphe izexwayiso zomhlinzeki, futhi uvume imikhawulo emisha yethrafikhi.
ui.turn_on_protection_to_scan_files: Vula ukuvikelwa ukuze uskene amafayela kule khompyutha futhi uqaphe i-ransomware nokwebiwa kwemininingwane yokungena.
